result.summary: Several visual and layout issues: a loading spinner overlays a popular restaurant card, restaurant names and category chips are truncated, and a large empty gap appears under the promo banner.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is centered over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, blocking the food photo and making the card look broken or stuck mid-load.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image has loaded, or show a proper skeleton/placeholder instead of overlaying an indefinite loader on content that appears otherwise ready.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card truncates the restaurant name to 'Trattoria Piccol', cutting off the rest of the text.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line names, reduce font size slightly, or ensure cards have enough width/padding so full names are visible.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow horizontally with a partial chip visible on the right edge and no clear affordance that the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/scroll indicators or ensure the last visible chip isn't awkwardly clipped; support horizontal scroll with proper padding.

issues.description: A large empty white gap sits between the green promo banner and the 'Fastest near you' section, making the layout feel sparse and uneven.
issues.suggestion: Tighten vertical spacing so sections sit closer together and the page feels more cohesive.

issues.description: Delivery fee on Green Bowl Poké is shown as '€0.90 delivery', which is unusually low next to others and may be a data/display inconsistency (or easy to misread).
issues.suggestion: Verify fee data and use consistent formatting (e.g. '€0.90 delivery') across all cards; highlight free delivery more clearly when applicable.
